claims.claim_text: The indexed Major General Frank R. McCoy probably corresponds to the Army major general of that name documented in contemporary newspapers.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Independent 1936 and 1942 newspapers identify a Major General Frank R. McCoy in senior Army and military-commission roles, matching the index's full name and exceptional rank.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Probable: exact full-name and exceptional-rank agreement across the NARA index and independent contemporary sources, but no protected identifier or direct personnel-file linkage has been reviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources establish biographical identity context from 1936 and 1942 but do not establish when or why an OSS personnel file was created or identify an immediate pre-OSS affiliation.
claims.match_notes: This is a qualified identity finding, not an employer claim. Box 501 is required to confirm the OSS relationship and predecessor chronology.

claims.claim_text: The protected identifier printed for indexed Corporal William J. McCoy conflicts with the official Army bulk entry attached to that identifier.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official Army entry assigns the same protected identifier to a wholly different name and a different grade; the number is withheld from public output.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting: protected-identifier agreement is outweighed by complete name disagreement and a grade conflict; the Army identity must not be assigned to McCoy.
claims.temporal_assessment: The conflict concerns identity resolution only and supplies no reliable pre-OSS employer or affiliation chronology.
claims.match_notes: Review the original Box 501 file and adjacent index documentation to determine whether the printed identifier is displaced, mistranscribed, or otherwise erroneous. No full identifier is published.
